source_grounding.retest_state: RETESTING persists after price returns into the frozen retest zone until fail/rebreak/expiry.
source_grounding.whitepaper_failure: a retest may tolerate shallow penetration; causal acceptance beyond the invalidation buffer sends the event to FAILED.
source_grounding.provenance_gap: exact memory/reset semantics of tick-persistent failure acceptance are not preserved.

diagnostic_profiles.name: CONTROL_CONSECUTIVE_BUFFER_TICKS
diagnostic_profiles.pending_reset: any tick not beyond adverse buffer

diagnostic_profiles.name: LATCH_RESET_AT_BOUNDARY_RECLAIM
diagnostic_profiles.pending_reset: directional price reclaims original boundary L
diagnostic_profiles.confirm: next later adverse-buffer tick before reset

diagnostic_profiles.name: LATCH_RESET_AT_RETEST_ZONE_EXIT
diagnostic_profiles.pending_reset: price exits retest zone in original breakout direction
diagnostic_profiles.confirm: next later adverse-buffer tick before reset

diagnostic_profiles.name: BREACH_THEN_NEXT_PREBREAK_TICK_CONFIRM
diagnostic_profiles.pending_reset: directional price reclaims original boundary L
diagnostic_profiles.confirm: next later tick remains on pre-break side after initial adverse-buffer breach

selection_rule: Carry forward only a categorical failure-memory interpretation that materially reduces excess trades/gross loss while retaining historical winners and without changing the frozen buffer or any numeric vector parameter.
